book.name: Epesusa
book.title: EPESUSA TANGE DUPANYA POLOME PEPA PYAO PYASAKAMAIYAMO DOKO

content: Kraisanya Yonge Dokonya Mendai Jetae Katapengena Leamo Doko

Dopana, nambame Kamongonya kalai doko pyakamaipusa, namba anjetae palelyo dokome, nyakama kyeto joo dapa langilyo: Goteme nyakama wii lao nyiana lao masetala, nyakamame auu pyoo mana minapengeli pyoo minao kalyepape.
Dopa pyoo katao, nyakama etete anasale joo katapala, yapa imbu nakaeyao, tambo-tambo lao kalyepape. Kristene yangi dupa maka nakaeyao, mende auu kae-kae pyoo kalyepape.
Spirita doko-kisa nyakama mendai jetae katao, mona setao katamana lao nee kaeyao kalyepape.
Yonge mendai iki katenge. Spirita mendai ikiaka katenge. Dopaleaka joo, Goteme nyakama mende ditona leamo doko iki nee kaeyao malisoo kalyepale lao nyakama wii lao nyia.
Kamongo mendai iki katenge. Tungi pingi mendai iki singi. Kaimbu nyingi mendai ikiaka singi.
Naima pitakanya Gote mendai iki, Takange doko katenge. Baa endakali dupa pitakanya alyasale katenge. Baa endakali dupa pitaka-kisa katenge. Baa naima pitakanya mona andaka katenge.
Kraisame ditoo lao masiamoli pyoo, baanya kondo kaenge doko naima mendai-mendai lao mokosoo dia.
Dopa piamo dokonya, pii mende dapa lao pepa pyapae silyamo: “Baa kaiti-kisa pao pituu, endakali anjetae dupa mokao nyoo laminao pupala, oapi epe dupa endakali dokaita mokosoo maiyana” lapae silyamo.
“Baa kaiti-kisa peana” lao pepa pyapae silyamo dokonya tenge aipale mende palenge? “Baa kaiti-kisa peana” lapae silyamo dokonya, baa isa yuu dakenya koko peakana lao panelyamo.
Isa yuu dakenya koko peamo akali mendai dokomeaka dupa pitakanya tumbasotoo latala, kaiti-kisa ulusale-waka pyakalyia.
Pyakalyetala baame akali mendapu aposole kalai doko maiya. Mendapu propeta kalai doko maiya. Mendapu wai pii epe lamaingi kalai doko maiya. Mendapu pasta kalaipi, mana lenge kalaipi dupa maiya.

Kalai dutupa maiyamo endakali dupame endakali Gotenya latae dupa depa lasina lao maiya. Dopa pitaminopa, endakali Gotenya latae dupame Gotenya kalai pyakamaiyoo, Kraisanya yonge doko andasina lao kalai dutupa maiya.
Kraisanya yonge doko andasoo pituu, naima pitaka mendai jetala baa tungi pyao, Gotenya Ikiningi doko dopalena lao masoo, Kristene wambu petae katao, Kraisa-yale etao katatama gii dokonya tuu latama.

Naima ŋaŋa joaka nakatenya, Kristene wambu petae katatama dokopa, poome endaki buli pilyamopa, soo yangi pyasa-pyasa pingili pyoo, endakali waa katapae dupanya sambo pii wasoo mana latami dupame naima minakasetala soo yangi pyasa-pyasa napitami.
Naimame endakali dupa auu kaeyao kiningi pii doko lao, mana dupa pitakanya andao wambu petala, naimanya akali aiyomba Kraisa doko katengeli pyoo katatama.

Yongenya katenge dupanya mendai-mendaimi kalai waka-waka pilyaminopa, yonge doko pitaka mendai joo auu pyoo katengeli pyoo, naima Kraisa-kisa katao, mende auu kae-kae pyoo, kalai waka-waka pilyamanopa, Kraisanya yonge doko andao auu pyoo katenge.
Endakali Enenge Jisetae Dupame Mana Minapenge Dupanya Leamo Doko
Dopana, Kamongonya kenge dokonya nambame pii dake kyeto joo langilyo: Akali tata waka yangi dupanya masingi doko etete koeyapaena, indupa pituu dupanya mana dupa yakinalapape.
Dupanya masingi dupa iminjetae katenge. Dupanya mona dupa kana jilyami dokome, pii soo nyingi mana doko dupa-kisa nasingi. Tenge dokonya, Goteme lete katenge maingi doko dupame kandao nanyingima.
Endakali dokaitame elya nakaeyao, yongenya pyoani kaenge mana koeyapae dupa minao, kaimala pipae mana dupa pitaka minao, popaita pyao katengema.
Dopaka doko, Kraisanya lao wai pii doko nyakamame soo nyiamino dokopa, mana koo dopale dupa nyala naeyami.
Nambame lelyo doko, nyakamame Kraisanya lao wai pii doko sepala, baanya mana dupa nyiamina lao masetala lelyo. (Kiningi pii doko Jisasa-kisa singi.)

Wamba nyakama yuunya endakali dupa katengemali pyoo kateaminopa, nyakamanya sambo pii lao minakasoani kaenge mana dokome nyakama koeyasiana, wamba nyakamanya mana miniami dupa yonge pee lyokengeli pyoo lyokao yakinatala,
nyakamanya imambupa, masingipa dolapo enenge jina kaeyalapape.
Dopa petala, mana tolatae dupapi, kiningi pii dokopi, dupa yonge pee enenge joo petala, Gote waingi tao wasepae kalyamanona lao masetala, baanya latae kalyepape.
Naima pitaka yonge mendai dokonyaka kalyamanona, nyakamame sambo lenge mana doko yakinatala, patali maki dupa kiningi pii doko lamaiyoo kalyepape.
Nyakama imbu pitamopa, koo mende pyaa naeyalapape. Nyakama imbu kaeyatae katao, niki landa pina lao kaeyala naeyalapape.
Imbu kaenge dokonya-kaita Satane panda maitamina, kandao kalyepape.
Indupa pituu, pake nenge dupame pake nala naenya, daa jepae dupa mokosoo maimana lao, nyakamanya kingimi lekeleke tao kalai epe pitami dupame muni nyepenge.

Nyakamanya nenge-kaita pii koo mende pyakalyina lao kaeyala naeyalapape. Nyakamanya pii setami endakali dupa kyeto maimana lao, pii epe mende lapenge jia-kandeno doko, endakali dupa kondo kaeyao pii epe dupa lapape.
Mokao nyepenge gii doko palitamopa nyakama mokao nyotopa lao, Gotenya Oli Spirita dokome nyakama Gotenyana lao kongali pinya kateana, nyakamame Oli Spirita doko kenda pisala naeyalapape.
Mona koo palengepi, tii lengepi, imbu kaengepi, laiya lengepi, lao nepengepi, luiyao koo pingipi, dupa pitaka yakinalapape.
Goteme Kraisa-kisa naimanya koo dupa kame sekeamoli pyoo, nyakama-lapo koo dupa kame sakamai-sakamai pyoo, mana epe minao, kondo kaeyao kalyepape.
